overview: RLAC formulates free-form generation as an adversarial game between a generator and a learned critic, where the critic proposes likely-failed rubrics verified by an external validator to dynamically construct preference data for DPO training.

modules.name: Experiment Config & Infrastructure
modules.description: Manages global hyperparameters (K, N, beta, learning rates), experiment setup, seed initialization, and device management for reproducible training.

modules.name: Prompt Engineering & Templating
modules.description: Constructs input contexts for the Generator (task instruction) and the Critic (instruction + generation + specific critic templates from Appendix B) for both factual text and code tasks.

modules.name: Generator Policy Wrapper
modules.description: Handles the sampling of K candidate outputs from the generator policy given an instruction s.

modules.name: Critic Policy Wrapper
modules.description: Handles the sampling of N criteria (error facts or test cases) from the critic policy given an instruction s and a generated output a.

modules.name: Fact Validator (Text)
modules.description: Validates critic-proposed facts by checking authenticity (entailment) and verifying correctness using external knowledge bases (FactScore component).

modules.name: Test Case Validator (Code)
modules.description: Validates critic-proposed test cases by executing them against reference solutions to get expected outputs and then against generated code to determine binary correctness.

modules.name: Reward & Preference Construction
modules.description: Translates binary validation outcomes into preference pairs (chosen vs. rejected) for both the generator (outputs) and the critic (criteria).

modules.name: DPO Algorithm Core
modules.description: Implements the Direct Preference Optimization loss calculations for updating the generator and critic parameters relative to their reference policies.

modules.name: RLAC Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Executes the main training loop described in Algorithm 1, coordinating generation, critique, validation, preference construction, and policy updates.

modules.name: Text Generation Evaluator
modules.description: Computes factual accuracy metrics (FactScore) and counts of correct/incorrect facts for biography generation tasks.

modules.name: Code Generation Evaluator
modules.description: Runs generated code against test suites (HumanEval, MBPP, etc.) to compute Pass@k and correctness scores.

modules.name: Verification Cost Tracker
modules.description: Monitors and logs the number of external validator calls to measure the efficiency and scalability of the verification process.

modules.name: Ablation & Baseline Controller
modules.description: Manages configurations for running ablation studies (Static Critic, Noisy Validator) and baseline methods (ArmoRM, FactTune-FS).

modules.name: Visualization & Analysis
modules.description: Generates plots for training dynamics (FactScore vs. Rounds), verification efficiency (Score vs. Calls), and exploration behavior (Score vs. KL divergence).
